title: BUSTA: Teaching Small Language Models to Reason About Binary Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.36288v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) are increasingly applied to Reverse Engineering (RE) workflows. RE, however, differs from common LLM coding tasks as it requires models to reason about low-level program behavior. Furthermore, the deployment of tooling in resource-constrained sandboxed RE environments limits the ability to use frontier-scale solutions. We examine whether a targeted LLM training approach can transfer distinct RE skills to open models via inverse basic-block execution: given an x86-64 basic block and a desired output register state, the model predicts the input register values that produce it. Fine-tuning \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B} and \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises knowable-register prediction accuracy from 73.2\% to 85.3\% and from 63.3\% to 95.2\%, respectively. translated_title: BUSTA：教会小型语言模型对二进制执行进行推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地应用于逆向工程（RE）工作流程中。然而，逆向工程与常见的LLM编程任务不同，它要求模型对底层程序行为进行推理。此外，在资源受限的沙箱化逆向工程环境中部署工具，限制了前沿大规模模型解决方案的使用能力。我们研究了一种针对性的LLM训练方法能否通过逆向基本块执行任务，将独特的逆向工程技能迁移到开源模型上：给定一个x86-64基本块和期望的输出寄存器状态，模型需要预测能产生该状态的输入寄存器值。使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）对Qwen3-1.7B和Nemotron-3-Nano进行微调后，可推知寄存器的预测准确率分别从73.2%提升至85.3%，以及从63.3%提升至95.2%。前沿模型仍然得分最高（最高达99.2%），但我们微调后的Nemotron-3-Nano与其仅相差四个百分点。
tldr: 通过“逆向基本块执行”训练任务结合GRPO强化学习微调，小型开源模型（1.7B级别）在二进制逆向推理能力上可逼近前沿大模型，从而能在资源受限的沙箱逆向工程环境中高效部署。
